summary: Two reproducible source blockers prevent preparation and complete-profile collection. CPU/import evidence and the 66-source map are valid within their stated narrow scopes; no new real tracking or formal metrics are established.

blocking_findings.title: Preparation uses an undefined training CLI attribute
blocking_findings.finding: The submitted CLI creates output/profile/reference_evaluation/source_gate only. The selection writer reads args.training, so the coordinator prepare_U0 stage raises AttributeError before creating selection.json or starting qualification.

reproduction.scope: Exact supplied CLI AST and exact unresolved attribute AST; no preparation main, transport, or neural call.

blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Use the training_result_sha256 already bound into the immutable reference bundle; do not add a second independently selectable training input.

blocking_findings.title: VOT event loop overwrites the model name before collection
blocking_findings.finding: The model name is assigned at collector line 12, then overwritten by each event filename at line 43. Line 46 seeks <last-event-filename>.json_full127.json instead of the official CAD_U1_same_R0_fixed6_full127.json (or U2 equivalent). After B1 is fixed, the first complete profile cannot be collected and the suite cannot advance to U2. The same overwritten name would also contaminate VOT rows and gates if an incorrectly named analysis file existed.

blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Rename the event-loop variable (for example event_name) and preserve the model name for analysis lookup, result rows, and gates.

nonblocking_findings.title: The one-time asset-hashing claim is contradicted by the inherited runtime
nonblocking_findings.finding: SOURCE_SPEC declares one-time asset hashing and no unused training-warm rehash per VOT anchor. Every vot_track calls CAD checked_plan; it invokes checked_R0_plan and thereby m122 checked_plan, which hashes the baseline final, training result, native checkpoint and CLIP weights. CAD make_bundle also calls verify_predecessor, which rehashes R0 final and result files. There is no memoization or immutable cached verification in these functions. This is an unsupported performance/source-description claim, not a measured runtime regression or a reason to modify the current R0.
nonblocking_findings.action: Correct the claim, or make a separately reviewed CAD-side change if avoiding repeated hashing is a requirement. Preserve frozen R0 sources.

nonblocking_findings.title: CPU/import evidence does not establish executable end-to-end admission
nonblocking_findings.finding: All three receipts explicitly record zero real tracking. Both pipeline import receipts record zero entrypoint main executions; the early import uses an older runtime hash. The final66 receipt fixes the layout/version scope but still does not exercise preparation, qualification, collection, TraX, resources, or launch admission.
nonblocking_findings.action: Keep these as CPU/source checks. Do not promote them to actual deployment, real64 qualification, full U0 parity, or new formal metrics.

nonblocking_findings.title: Scientific coordinator exists; a CAD-specific local admission/deployment operator is absent from the package
nonblocking_findings.finding: CANDIDATE is still candidate_M125_CAD_uniform_inference_source_gate. The supervisor/coordinator consume a pre-existing reviewed gate but do not verify this report or create/admit that gate. The reused operator main is explicitly regional: it requires an arm, different candidate files/status, 11 new/64 staged files, and launches regional training. Only verify_predecessor/resource_admission are reused by the CAD coordinator. No CAD-specific staging/review-bound gate producer or actual deployment/admission receipt is supplied.
nonblocking_findings.action: Treat the source package as implemented scientific orchestration requiring correction and later explicit admission, not as an admitted launch. The absence is an execution boundary, separate from B1/B2.

nonblocking_findings.title: VOT event hashes are designed, but actual event-to-trajectory evidence is unavailable
nonblocking_findings.finding: The source emits one exclusive event file keyed by the legal initialization key, validates profile/final/bundle and unique cardinality 1765, sums counters, and seals/rechecks event hashes. The analyzer does not independently match its key set or tracking-call totals to each official trajectory. No actual events or results are in the allowed evidence. Therefore the source supports implemented counter instrumentation, not an independently recounted completed VOT counter result.
nonblocking_findings.action: At completed-result review, distinguish sealed emitted counts from independently reconciled trajectory counts. No speculative fallback or unrelated refactor is requested.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: OPE tracking uses the sealed initialization box plus RGB/depth frames; subsequent groundtruth.txt is opened only in post-prediction analysis. VOT consumes the official initial rectangle and subsequent images. The bank maps legal RGB-byte/box keys, with historical multi-frame human review disclosed. Training provenance checks require the original Train152 six-pass final. No actual dataset or running R0 artifacts were opened in this audit.

B_score_normalization.details: The OPE metric invocation, resolution and hash remain unchanged from R0. VOT reads the same official baseline result indices and converts fractions to percent with multiplication by 100. No own-prediction max/min/mean denominator is introduced. The selected native response controls writes while best_score remains the final selected ABC score. Official external metric implementations are hash-pinned and were not fetched/rerun.

C_result_existence_and_version.details: Primary CPU receipts exist and are hash-verified. Four policy/tensor sources match current source; the early import records 12 import successes but its runtime digest is old (010dfd61...), with the other 11 CAD modules and operator matching. Final66 records all 12 imports, exact 66-source layout and 16 locked inputs. Its full raw source map is copied unchanged into audited_staged_source_sha256. No new CAD GPU/formal metric result is claimed or established; source completeness is blocked by B1/B2.

D_reachable_execution_and_dead_code.details: The scientific coordinator explicitly reaches qualification, OPE analysis, official VOT analysis, sealing and collection; these are not unused metric definitions. However preparation always fails on the unsupported training attribute and collection later fails because event filenames shadow the model name. Import-only checks cannot detect these failures.

E_scope_assessment.details: Observed evidence is scalar policy tests, synthetic tensor interface tests and CPU imports. Planned U1/U2 rows require DT Test50/76373 frames, CDTB80/101956 frames and VOT127/1765 anchors/5295 files. U0 is expressly the original complete R0 result; the new U0 path adds only 64 tracking calls and a 65-row six-decimal box/score prefix comparison. None proves a new full U0 rerun, hidden-state bit parity, tracking gains, C usefulness, or full nine-metric success.

F_evaluation_type.details: Policy/tensor/interface fixtures are synthetic logic simulations, with the old tracker as a consistency reference, not performance ground truth. Import checks are static interface evidence. The intended full benchmark pipeline is real_gt with dataset/official protocol annotations used after predictions. No simulation score is represented as dataset performance.

supplemental_checks.subject: One final and one uniform profile per complete row
supplemental_checks.details: Runtime reconstructs the exact bundle/plan from the original completed R0 final and one named profile. No dataset/sequence-specific weight, seed, layer, or profile branch is present. Optional U3/U4 are excluded from the primary gate and CLI.

supplemental_checks.subject: Official CAD versus this adaptation
supplemental_checks.details: Official CADTrack uses a Hann response maximum, interval 5, strict threshold 0.65 and template slot preservation. The local adaptation uses the native response at the ABC-selected cell and retains current-quality C for U0/U1/U2. Official LasHeR/RGBT training/normalization and CAD network are not imported. This is a strategy comparison, not a CAD network reproduction or a new original module.

supplemental_checks.subject: Strict thresholds and selected-cell qualification
supplemental_checks.details: Response qualification and C acceptance both use strict >. Profiled tracker samples native_response at selected[0], never an unrelated native maximum. Pure policy 5416 checks were independently rerun with stdlib, and the supplied mock has an unrelated larger native peak at cell 3 to exercise this distinction.

supplemental_checks.subject: Prediction, state, query, features and template semantics
supplemental_checks.details: The first 20 statements of old/new step have identical normalized AST, covering the observation/decoder and committed selected box, native query, selected feature and selected native response. Reporting keeps final ABC confidence; only the write gate changes. A qualified accepted write appends the six-channel crop and pops slot 1, retaining the initial slot. Synthetic U0 receipt covers 100 steps and matching C inputs; no real long-run parity is inferred.

supplemental_checks.subject: C participation and counters
supplemental_checks.details: U0/U1/U2 call C on every qualified write event using the unchanged 519-value current/previous/initial/quality/motion feature function and threshold 0.5. U4 bypasses C and is explicitly optional/unqueued. Counters reset per initialization and increment actual code paths; OPE collector checks tracking_calls=frames-1. Supplied synthetic receipt records U4 C_evaluations=0.

supplemental_checks.subject: Final66 dependency/sibling resolution
supplemental_checks.details: All 66 prospective sources hash-match local files: 12 CAD modules, 53 original R0/frozen dependency sources and one frozen R2 operator. All parse with Python AST. Final66 recorded package origins are internally consistent with that separate layout. All 12 modules and 9 guarded entrypoints were inspected; the library-only modules have no CLI. Import success does not establish main behavior.

supplemental_checks.subject: End-to-end final/profile/bundle/plan/receipt/collection binding
supplemental_checks.details: Bindings reconstruct the exact reference plan, final, source gate, profile and output paths and check receipt/result hashes. The intended chain is meaningful, but B1 prevents selection creation and B2 breaks official analysis lookup/model identity at collection. Source cannot be accepted end-to-end until both are corrected.

supplemental_checks.subject: Official metric and scope locks
supplemental_checks.details: Full OPE cardinalities and frame totals are unchanged. VOT uses frozen 127-sequence/1765-anchor manifest, official analysis command and 5295 result-file merge. OPE call, VOT metric extraction and all nine pass thresholds are AST-identical to original R0. Counter files are outside official prediction result directories.

supplemental_checks.subject: Time, source, predecessor and resource ordering; no automatic retry
supplemental_checks.details: Suite checks optimization flag and not-before time before reading its gate, then source/input hashes, completed predecessor and GPU-memory/disk admission before launching stages. Runtime bundle creation also checks time first. Frozen predecessor verifier requires both zero exits, terminal receipt, all six complete passes and three result receipts. Only GPU index/memory fields are queried. Subprocess nonzero exits assert and VOT restart=false; no autoretry loop is introduced. None of these admissions was executed by this audit.

supplemental_checks.subject: Preservation of fixed R0 and audit inputs
supplemental_checks.details: All 79 local inputs are byte-identical before/after, including all 53 original R0 Python/frozen sources. All reviewer writes remain under the new audit output directory. No current R0 status/log/process/weights/resources were read; remote immutability or progress is not newly attested.
